C-STABILIZE-TRAIN-ADMISSION.Summary: Separate early train admission evidence from owner acceptance according to release-train rules3/4, without weakening release readiness or publication authority.
C-STABILIZE-TRAIN-ADMISSION.ApprovalBasis: Owner-approved RECOVERY and delegated recommended choices, 2026-11-09. Coordinator explicitly authorized this concrete pre-admission blocker repair: pending/no owner acceptance in Collecting, Preparing and Frozen requires a complete explicit testingProtocol, while Ready, Released and strict mode retain complete real owner acceptance. No further approval/review round, train admission mutation, release authorization or version decision is delegated by this change.

Goals.Goal: Allow pending/absent owner acceptance only in Collecting/Preparing/Frozen with explicit complete automatic/manual/intentionallyUnverified protocol sections.
Preserve legacy complete acceptance and all version, lifecycle, accounting, required-check, freeze/seal/tag and authorization gates.
Ready, Released, explicit strict manifest validation and direct strict repository validation require complete owner acceptance; pending, rejected and needs-recheck labels cannot publish.

Constraints.Constraint: Separate tree based7e1bd10; keep frozen product, checkbox, native and QA preparation unchanged. Do not mutate any train manifest, release materials, version, tag or publication workflow.
Focused deterministic fixture tests only, existing dependencies, VITEST_MAX_WORKERS=2; no full suite, timeout/assertion weakening, commits, push or new reviews.

NonGoals.NonGoal: No actual admission, PR/CI verdict fabrication, owner acceptance fabrication, artifact build or release dispatch.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Reproduce the confirmed owner-acceptance admission failure in a complete-protocol early-state fixture before changing the validator.

Early pending/absent acceptance passes only with complete protocol; missing sections/actual result/evidence/date/manual build or missing explicit unverified reasons fail. Legacy complete acceptance remains valid.
Strict/Ready/Released reject missing/pending/rejected/needs-recheck acceptance; complete accepted Ready and existing exact seal/check/authorization fixtures pass.
Update only M046/V046 current projections and local contracts; pass selected baseline, target/final command gates and post-archive current/status.

AffectedAreas.Area: M-046 release-readiness validator and its focused deterministic tests.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedCommand: npx --no-install vitest run tests/renderer/release-readiness.test.js tests/renderer/release-train.test.js tests/renderer/release-governance.test.js
VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Red-to-green fixture failure, protocol schema example, strict boundary negative controls and unchanged legacy/current-train compatibility; no real train mutation.
